title: QA Engineer I
jobDescription:
Role Overview: We are looking for a highly motivated QA Engineer with 1 to 2 years of experience to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will work closely with the Amagi Onboarding Linear QA team to ensure high-quality Linear deliveries. You will be involved in all stages of Onboarding a Customer from reviewing requirements to executing tests, identifying defects, and suggesting improvements. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Review and analyse system specifications and requirements. * Develop and execute manual and automated test cases based on requirements and technical designs. * Identify, record, document, and track defects through testing tools. * Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Support the creation and execution of automated test scripts and report results. * Communicate testing progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders in a clear, concise manner. * Assist in reproducing and isolating bugs and following up on resolutions. * Assist in developing and maintaining test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and user manuals.

QUALIFICATIONS:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 1-2 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing. * Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies. * Familiarity with bug tracking tools such as JIRA. * Experience with manual testing; exposure to automation tools like Selenium, JUnit, or Robot Framework is a plus. * Knowledge of scripting languages (Python) is an advantage. * Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment with good communication and interpersonal skills. Nice to Have: * Knowledge on OTT, SSAI, Media Domain * Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and API testing tools (Postman). Join us and be part of a diverse team that values innovation and creativity. As a QA Engineer I, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on our products and customer experiences. If you are passionate about quality assurance and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply and embark on a rewarding career journey with us!

title: Senior Business Development Representative
jobDescription: Born in India, Built for the World Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication. Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers: * 9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors * 500,000+ hours of content processed * 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate. Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore <https://www.amagi.com/social-impact>here <https://www.amagi.com/social-impact>. Work Mode : In-Office Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road) Role Overview: The Business Development Representative (BDR) – Ads Business will play a critical role in driving outbound pipeline generation and strategic account development across regions. This role requires a highly proactive individual with strong outbound prospecting experience, understanding of the media and advertising ecosystem, and the ability to engage senior stakeholders across broadcasters, OTT platforms, agencies, advertisers, and FAST partners. You will work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Product teams to identify opportunities, generate qualified meetings, and contribute to Amagi’s advertising revenue growth. What will you own? 1/ Prospecting & Pipeline Generation: * Identify and research high-potential accounts across regions within Broadcast, OTT, FAST, CTV, Advertising, and Media sectors. * Conduct outbound prospecting through email, calls, Linked In, and social channels to generate qualified opportunities. * Engage with senior decision-makers including Revenue Heads, Ad Sales Leaders, Digital Strategy teams, and Content Monetisation stakeholders. * Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified meetings for the Ads Sales team.2/ Account Mapping & Market Research: * Partner with Sales leadership to prioritise strategic target accounts and growth markets. * Conduct account mapping to identify key stakeholders, buying centres, and organisational structures. * Stay updated on regional media trends, advertising shifts, FAST ecosystem developments, and competitive landscape.3/ Campaign Execution & Sales Collaboration: * Execute outbound campaigns aligned to regional GTM priorities and Ads business objectives. * Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams on messaging, outreach sequences, and vertical-specific positioning. * Contribute insights from prospect conversations to improve targeting and campaign effectiveness.4/ CRM & Operational Excellence: * Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and activity tracking within Salesforce and prospecting tools. * Ensure timely logging of prospect interactions, account updates, and qualification notes. * Provide structured handoff notes and qualification summaries to the Sales team. What are we looking for? * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field. * 5+ years of experience in Business Development, SDR/BDR, or Sales roles within Saa S, Ad Tech, Media Tech, Broadcast, OTT, or Digital Advertising industries. * Proven success in outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across markets. * Strong understanding of the media, advertising, OTT, FAST, or connected TV ecosystem. * Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and relationship-building skills. * Experience using Salesforce, Linked In Sales Navigator, Outreach.io, and modern prospecting tools. * Self-driven, highly organised, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. * Additional Asian language proficiency is an added advantage. Life at Amagi: Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day. * Be Vulnerable, Be You. Authenticity is our baseline. * Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity. * Have Fun with Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks. * Think Macro, Do Micro. We dream big but execute with relentless precision. A Place That Takes Care of You: We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

1. INFRASTRUCTURE & WORKSPACE MANAGEMENT * Provision and maintain platform infrastructure across AWS and GCP following governance standards. * Set up and manage workspaces, storage buckets, networking, and lifecycle configurations. * Maintain consistent operational standards across multi-cloud environments.

6. title: Manager - Program Management
jobDescription:
About Amagi We are a next-generation media technology company that provides cloud broadcast and targeted advertising solutions to broadcast TV and streaming TV platforms. Amagi enables content owners to launch, distribute, and monetize live linear channels on Free Ad-supported Streaming TV and video services platforms. Amagi also offers 24x7 cloud-managed services bringing simplicity, advanced automation, and transparency to the entire broadcast operations. Overall, Amagi supports 700+ content brands, 800+ playout chains, and over 2500 channel deliveries on its platform in over 40 countries. Amagi has a presence in New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, London, Paris, Melbourne, Seoul, Singapore, and broadcast operations in New Delhi, and an innovation center in Bangalore. For more information visit us atwww.amagi.com <http://www.amagi.com/>

ROLE:
Manager
- Program Management Location: Bangalore Department: Program Management Amagi is seeking an experienced Manager
- Program Management (TPM) to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of critical technical programs for enterprise customers. As a TPM, you will leverage ametrics-driven approach to ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and with the highest quality. You will also collaborate extensively with both internal teams and onsite customer-facing project management and technical teams, ensuring seamless communication and successful program execution. This role requires a deep understanding of product functionality, strong technical expertise, and the ability to translate customer needs into actionable plans. You will use your ability to manage by data, deliver strategic insights, and guide cross-functional teams to achieve program goals. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Program Planning & Execution Excellence · Detailed Planning: Lead the creation of comprehensive, actionable plans for all technical programs, defining scope, schedule, and quality metrics. Ensure that all program milestones, including feature releases, defect resolutions, and customer deployments, are meticulously planned and tracked. · Metrics-Driven Execution: Manage program performance using quantitative metrics such as project timelines, resource allocation, issue tracking, and customer satisfaction scores. Use data to inform decision-making, proactively identify risks, and adjust plans when necessary. · Risk & Contingency Planning: Identify potential risks early in the planning phase, develop mitigation strategies, and maintain a risk register to ensure timely action. · Predictability & Transparency: Ensure predictability in program delivery by consistently monitoring and reporting progress against plan. jobDescription:
Born in India, Built for the World Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication. Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers: * 9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors * 500,000+ hours of content processed * 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate. Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore <https://www.amagi.com/social-impact>here <https://www.amagi.com/social-impact>. Work Mode : In-Office Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road) Role Overview: The Tech Lead will act as the main technical interface point with assigned customers to ensure that channel go-live happens on time, with quality. Be a partner to Project Manager and provide technical leadership during customer calls. It's a joint responsibility of the tech lead and PM to teach customers and educate them about whats possible and what's not. What will you own? * Understand how customers deliver assets, metadata, playlists, and other inputs, and write requirement specifications for the Customization team. * Understand customer requirements related to automation, customization, reporting, and other workflows; document the requirements and coordinate with the Engineering and Customization teams for implementation. * Work with customers and internal teams to manage and accommodate changes in requirements throughout the project lifecycle. * Understand customer requirements and advise them on how to leverage Amagi's products and services to meet their business needs. * Work closely with Implementation Engineers to deploy and configure Amagi's and third-party software solutions, ensuring accurate configuration and successful deployment. * Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers and partners. * Adopt quality as a mindset by ensuring that everything delivered to the customer is thoroughly tested and works as expected. Validate the technical work completed by the Product, Engineering, Customization, Dev Ops, and Implementation teams before customer delivery. * Develop a deep understanding of all Amagi products and services. * Guide, train, and mentor Project Engineers. * Work with the Engineering team to understand new features and enable customer requirements that are not currently supported by the product. * Be available to work in the US shift. What are we looking for? * Our ideal candidate has atleast 8 years of experience in the Media Tech domain, with at least 2 of them in an external customer-facing role. * Expertise in Playout and Live orchestration systems * Expertise in asset and metadata ingest and transcoding * Expertise in at least one scheduling system * Expertise in at least one playout system and graphics insertion system * Experience in working with Transport Stream and various encoders * Expertise in stream delivery over internet technologies
- SRT, Zixi, HLS, DASH * Expertise in stream delivery over fiber, ASI, and SDI * Expertise in AWS media services
- Medialive, Mediastore, Media Tailor, etc * Knowledge of how EPG works * Good Communication Skills * Advanced Knowledge of various video codecs and standards * Advanced knowledge of how playout systems work * Good Interpersonal Skills * Good Communication Skills Life at Amagi: Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day. * Be Vulnerable, Be You. Authenticity is our baseline. * Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity. * Have Fun with Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks. * Think Macro, Do Micro. We dream big but execute with relentless precision. A Place That Takes Care of You: We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.
